title: Deployment message standard (PR number, commit, author, who deployed)
proves: The release watcher and build-server notifier show PR number(s), commit, author and deployer for merge-commit, squash, multi-PR and direct-push releases; in-progress/live/unchanged variants; fallback on API 500, timeout, bad or missing token; hostile PR titles and logins are sanitised; 1200-char cap; 1 h cache; the GitHub token never appears in the process list, output or logs. All against a local fake GitHub API and fake Chat receiver.
doesNotProve: A real GitHub token or API response shape on every edge, how Google Chat renders the text, or the systemd install on the production host.
